title: Luxembourg's Quantum Technologies Strategy
summary: National quantum technologies strategy issued by the Luxembourg Ministry of State, setting a roadmap toward secure quantum networks and explicitly addressing post-quantum cryptography (PQC) as a quantum-resistant solution integrable with existing systems.

title: Public consultation on the European Union roadmap for the transition to post-quantum cryptography
summary: Luxembourg government digital-trust portal announcement of a public consultation on the EU roadmap for transition to post-quantum cryptography, noting the recommendation that critical use cases migrate to PQC by end-2030 at the latest.

title: Quantum Communication in Luxembourg (factsheet)
summary: Official Luxembourg government factsheet outlining the national quantum strategy roadmap (Phase 1 2025-2027, Phase 2 2027-2030, Phase 3) for quantum communication infrastructure. PQC reference is not explicit in the available snippet, so flagged for human review.

title: L'ILNAS a participé à la 4ième conférence NISDUC à Luxembourg
summary: Luxembourg digital-trust portal (ILNAS) news item reporting Dr Michele Feltz's presentation at the 4th NISDUC conference (6-7 May 2025), which set out the quantum threat to public-key cryptography ('record now, decrypt later'), the NIST PQC standardisation process, and concrete recommendations for migrating to post-quantum cryptography.

title: PQC Readiness Survey Report 2026
summary: National Cybersecurity Competence Center (NC3) survey report, produced with LuxQuantum, assessing post-quantum cryptography maturity across 25+ Luxembourg organisations; it finds high PQC awareness (92%) but weak action (only 16% have run pilots, 11% have identified vulnerable systems) ahead of the EU's 2030 PQC deadline, and sets out five action imperatives including cryptographic inventory and crypto-agility.

title: Survey PQCReadiness: a NC3 self-assessment tool
issuingOrg: National Cybersecurity Competence Center (NC3), Luxembourg House of Cybersecurity
summary: Anonymous NC3 Luxembourg self-assessment questionnaire, now closed, for all businesses, SMEs included, to report their post-quantum cryptography readiness. It evaluated the overall ecosystem's readiness and awareness of the need to start PQC planning early, rather than auditing individual companies.

title: La stratégie du Luxembourg en matière de données (Accélérer la souveraineté numérique 2030)
summary: The national data strategy, produced by the Ministry of State, MESR, MECO and MinDigital, restates the ambition to speed up the transition to post-quantum cryptography. It also describes a cybersecurity flagship project that would provide test infrastructure and tools to help the Luxembourg ecosystem adopt PQC.

title: Luxembourg Cybersecurity Factory (AI 4 Lux)
summary: A government AI 4 Lux project page on the Luxembourg Cybersecurity Factory, which combines an open cybersecurity dataspace, an AI Cybersecurity Hub and a Quantum Lab to strengthen threat intelligence, AI governance and post-quantum readiness. Its plans for 2026-2030 include expanding Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) testing.

title: Standards Analysis ICT Sector Luxembourg, Version 17.0
summary: ILNAS's July 2026 analysis of ICT standardisation committees and Luxembourg's national involvement. Its profiles list ETSI TC CYBER WG QSC (Quantum-Safe Cryptography) and ETSI TC ESI WG PQC, and the WG PQC chair is a Luxembourg participant.

title: Quantum Technologies (Normes et Normalisation, secteur TIC)
summary: An ILNAS standardisation page (last updated 8 January 2026) on Luxembourg's involvement in quantum technology standardisation through national committee NSC 03, CEN/CLC JTC 22 and ISO/IEC JTC 3. In listing CEN/CLC JTC 22 work, it mentions a project document that will analyse the links between QKD and post-quantum cryptography.

title: Le Digital Learning Hub inaugure trois académies pour former les talents numériques de demain
summary: A Ministry of Education press release dated 16 June 2026 launching three Digital Learning Hub academies. The Quantum Computing Academy's curriculum includes post-quantum cryptography.
